_comment: Season expectation shift per club: last = actual 2025/26 PL points, pred = supercomputer-predicted 2026/27 points (Sky/EADT, 10k sims from Elo + transfers + betting markets, pulled 2026-08-17). Model applies factor = sqrt(pred/last) clamped 0.87-1.15 to attack rates and inversely to team xGC. Promoted clubs have no 'last' - factor 1.0 (their weak priors already handle it). Refresh or retire once current-season data takes over (Phase 2).
